system.description:
Also, at 2nd level your technique with corrosive chakra makes your combative medical techniques all the more abrasive. Damage you deal with a jutsu with the Medical keyword is increased by an amount equal to its rank (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5).

Additionally, when you deal damage with a jutsu with the Medical keyword, you reroll 1’s and 2’s, taking the second result.

Toxic Chakra – Blighted

Blighted is treated as an Elemental Condition.

A Blighted creature suffers the following effects;

A Blighted creature cannot gain Jutsu based bonuses to its AC or Damage.

An Envenomed creature cannot take its Bonus Action as it is suffering from severe poisoning.

A Corroded creature takes bonus poison damage equal to your Channeled Healing bonus from melee and ranged attacks, once per turn.

A Blighted creature can spend their Action retching to expel the toxins in their body, ending this condition.

castOption.label: Hematoxic Touch (+rank damage)
castOption.note: Reroll 1s and 2s on its damage dice.
